svg.title: MisaOS
svg.desc: Runs apps from another Linux on NixOS, each in a sealed root that sees only its own files and the folders a plan grants. It also boots its own host: a handoff verifies the generation, then starts Dinit as PID 1. Pictures: Boot in a VM: generation verified, then Dinit starts each service; Debian xclock running on NixOS; A tampered boot is refused.
